Using our app. By tapping Continue when these Terms are presented, you agree to them.
Please read them together with our Privacy Policy (https://towerclimber-game.netlify.app/privacy.html).
Purchases are optional, and your mandatory consumer rights remain protected.



1. Agreement and operator


These Terms govern our app and its game services.
The app is operated by Matej Samardjiev, trading as All Star Studios,
North Macedonia (“we” or “us”). Contact
support.allstarstudios@gmail.com (mailto:support.allstarstudios@gmail.com).


When these Terms are presented in the app, tapping Continue signifies agreement to that
version. If you disagree, do not continue using the app. Our
Privacy Policy (https://towerclimber-game.netlify.app/privacy.html) explains information processing. Acknowledging it
does not consent to optional advertising or waive privacy rights.



2. Eligibility


The minimum age is 13, or a higher age required by applicable law. If you cannot
legally enter this agreement yourself, your parent or guardian must review and agree to it
and authorize your use and purchases. A store content rating is different from the legal
age for contracting or consenting to data processing.


3. Accounts


You may play as a guest. Linking Google sign-in helps recover cloud progress while the
service operates. An unlinked guest may be unrecoverable after reinstalling, clearing data
or losing the device. Signing into an already linked account switches to it; separate
accounts are not automatically merged.


Protect your device and sign-in access and report suspected misuse. Do not sell accounts
or use someone else's credentials. You are responsible for your authorized use, not
automatically every unauthorized transaction or failure caused by us.



4. License and acceptable use


We grant a limited, personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable permission to use the app
and available content for non-commercial entertainment under these Terms. Software, art,
music, characters and other protected content remain ours or our licensors'. Purchases
grant described use rights, not ownership of the game's intellectual property.


Do not unlawfully copy or commercially distribute the app, bypass access controls,
falsify purchases or rewards, exploit bugs for items, interfere with services or access
another player's account. These restrictions do not prohibit acts expressly permitted
by applicable law. Report security and purchase problems to support.



5. Offline play and availability


Some gameplay, progress and unlocked content are stored on your phone. Sign-in, cloud
sync, purchase verification, account deletion and server rewards require connectivity.
Rewarded ads depend on ad availability and any required verification.


Offline actions are queued and reconciled on reconnection. Data loss, queue limits,
account switching, incompatible versions or rejected transactions can prevent changes
from carrying over. Reconnect periodically and confirm important progress is saved before
changing devices or deleting local data. Local storage is not guaranteed permanent
offline access or recovery.


Maintenance, errors, network failures and compatibility changes can interrupt the service.
We do not promise uninterrupted availability or support for every device forever.
Required updates, conformity obligations and mandatory consumer remedies remain applicable.



6. Virtual currency and items


Gold and character tokens work only in this game. They are not money or a bank balance
and cannot be sold, transferred between players or redeemed for cash through the game.
This does not exclude a legally required refund.



Gold: earned or purchased currency consumed when spent. Purchase
restoration does not replenish gold already spent.


Tokens: rewards used for character unlocks, including rewards for duplicate packs.


Characters: repeat-use account unlocks, not consumed each run. Access
still depends on retained account/device data and relevant game functionality.


Packs: random selections bought with gold, which itself can be purchased.
Duplicates award tokens. The store's “Pack odds” information describes configured rarity
chances; no particular or unowned character is guaranteed.


Remove Ads: a non-consumable entitlement that stops automatic
full-screen ads (interstitials). You can still voluntarily choose to watch rewarded ads
to receive an offered in-game reward. It does not disable all advertising technology or
all ad-related data processing; our Privacy Policy (https://towerclimber-game.netlify.app/privacy.html) explains those practices.
It does not guarantee
that the game or every online service operates forever.



“Owned” and “unlocked” describe ongoing rights within the game, not ownership of its
underlying content. Purchased currency has no scheduled expiry in the current game.
The shutdown section addresses loss of functionality if services end; it does not
introduce an automatic expiry date.



7. Purchases and restoration


The current shop offers gold bundles and Remove Ads through the supported app store.
A linked sign-in account is required to buy or restore. Review the store checkout's
amount, currency and tax treatment before authorizing payment. Use only payment methods
you are authorized to use.


The store and RevenueCat verify purchases; our backend applies rewards to the identified
game account. Payment confirmation and delivery are separate steps and delivery may be
delayed. Contact support with product and transaction references if an item is missing;
do not purchase again merely to retry delivery.


Use Restore purchases in the gold shop for eligible non-consumables
such as Remove Ads. This needs connectivity, the relevant store account and linked game
account. Where supported by the store/purchase configuration, restoration can move Remove
Ads to the current game account and remove it from the previous one, as the confirmation
explains. It does not merge accounts, recover deleted progress or grant spent gold again.
Cross-store transfer is not promised.



8. Refunds and statutory rights


Refunds, cancellation, withdrawal and remedies depend on store rules, applicable law and
the circumstances of the purchase. Contact the store or us for help. We offer no additional
general change-of-mind guarantee, but do not exclude remedies you are legally entitled to,
including for non-delivery or defective digital content.


Accepting general Terms does not itself waive statutory withdrawal rights. Where an
exception for immediate digital supply requires separate consent, acknowledgement or
confirmation, those conditions still apply. Purchased virtual currency must not automatically
be treated as digital content for which every withdrawal right disappears on delivery.


A refund or payment reversal may require adjustment of the related item or balance in
accordance with law and store rules. A legitimate refund request is not itself cheating.




9. Updates and balancing


We may change gameplay, rewards, balance, content and technical features for valid reasons
such as security, exploit prevention, fair balance, compatibility, legal compliance or
maintaining a viable service. This is not unrestricted permission to remove paid benefits
without regard to purchases and legal rights.


We will provide information and notice required by law. Material reductions in access
to or use of paid content remain subject to applicable termination and remedy rights.
New prices and pack chances apply to future transactions, not retroactive descriptions
of completed purchases.



10. Ending use and misuse


You may stop playing at any time. Uninstalling does not delete your server account.
Use the online Profile → Delete Account action or contact support.
The Privacy Policy explains verification, retained records and provider limitations.


Deletion removes account progress and entitlements. It is not a refund request and does
not erase store records or eliminate applicable non-consumable restoration or remedy rights.


We may take proportionate restrictions or corrective action where reasonably necessary
for fraud, security threats, unlawful conduct or a material breach. Where practicable and
lawful, we will explain the action and allow support review of a mistake. Urgent action may
precede notice. This does not authorize arbitrary confiscation of legitimate purchases.



11. Permanent discontinuation


The app and online services are not guaranteed to operate indefinitely.
We may discontinue the game or individual services for legitimate reasons, including
financial unsustainability, loss of necessary technology or provider support, security
or legal requirements, or a reasonable decision to end operation.


Where practicable, we will give reasonable advance notice through the app and/or website,
identifying affected features and the expected end date. Urgent circumstances or a legal
requirement may limit notice. Any notice or remedy required by law still applies.


After shutdown, accounts, cloud saves, verification, restoration, server rewards and
other dependent features may stop working. Access to purchased or earned currency,
characters and other server-dependent content may be lost. Game data may be deleted,
subject to necessary legal retention and the Privacy Policy.


Some installed content may continue offline, but the present game is not a guaranteed
standalone offline product. We do not promise a final offline edition, continued downloads
or compatibility, replacement servers, data migration or perpetual recovery of purchases.
Buying an ongoing unlock or non-consumable does not create an unlimited obligation to
maintain the game or its servers forever.


We will not knowingly sell access we cannot provide as described. Sales during a notified
wind-down must clearly explain material remaining limitations. Discontinuation does not
erase existing claims or override consumer law or store rules. Required refunds or remedies
depend on what was purchased and supplied, the reason and timing of shutdown and applicable
law.



12. Responsibility


We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation. To the extent permitted by law,
we are not responsible for business losses from a game licensed for personal entertainment,
or losses not reasonably foreseeable from our breach. This does not remove responsibilities
the law places on us for the service or its providers.


Nothing limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited, including applicable liability
for fraud, intentional misconduct, personal injury or mandatory consumer remedies.




13. Updated Terms


We may update Terms for service or legal changes. Released versions will have effective
dates and remain archived. Required versions are presented in the app; offline devices
learn of them on reconnection and updates detected during a climb are deferred until it ends.


An older acknowledgement does not accept newer Terms. Changes do not retrospectively
remove accrued rights. If you disagree, stop using the service and contact us about
outstanding purchases or rights. Legally required notice periods still apply.




14. Questions, disputes and applicable law


Contact support.allstarstudios@gmail.com (mailto:support.allstarstudios@gmail.com)
with questions or complaints. Describe the issue and include your Player ID or purchase
reference where relevant. Do not send passwords, sign-in tokens or full payment-card details.
We will review your complaint and work with you to resolve it.


These Terms are governed by the laws of North Macedonia. This choice does not deprive
you of mandatory consumer protections that apply in your country of habitual residence,
or your right to bring a claim before a court available to you under applicable law.
Contacting support is not a condition for exercising statutory rights.


If a provision is unenforceable, the remaining provisions continue to apply to the
extent permitted by law. A delay in enforcing a provision does not by itself waive it.
These Terms do not replace the separate terms applicable to your app-store account.
